points.description: Mentions that the frequency (वारंवारता) of the sound is different, leading to a difference in pitch (उच्चनीचता).

rubric.notes: Full marks are awarded for mentioning that different frequencies result in different pitches. No marks are awarded for vague answers that do not mention frequency or pitch.
rubric.answer_key: माणसांच्या आवाजाची वारंवारता (frequency) वेगवेगळी असते, त्यामुळे त्यांच्या आवाजाची उच्चनीचता (pitch) वेगवेगळी असते.
